description: When the person asks to connect their VibeRaven account, set userRequestedSignIn to true. Returns the public browser approval link promptly; the person must approve it themselves. Then call viberaven_account to read progress and the plan. Never approve a link for the person, request credentials or use sign-in for a free local check.

userRequestedSignIn.description: True only after the person asks to sign in. False or absent starts no flow.

name: viberaven_login
